objective: reduce preference non-monotonicity in continuous routing
limitations: Neither tie-aware decoding nor router-level monotonicity regularization reduced the deterministic-trajectory monotonicity violations; the gate remains false.

Root cause localized: the expected (soft) objective and the discrete argmax trajectory are decoupled, and the four frozen experts are under-separated (evacuated-GT spread ~5%), so a monotone expected objective does not yield a monotone realized KPI.
The real fix requires expert re-separation (Phase 11) or trajectory-level preference-aware decoding, not frozen-router regularization.
This checkpoint is a diagnostic artifact and is not accepted for the frontend; Phase 9B remains the experimental continuous-preference default.
Single seed, 100k transitions, synthetic weather/resources, fixed 30-vessel observation contract.
